_comment: Eight public Library articles, two per observed pillar. Real content, fetched once from the public pages on 2026-09-16. This is a sample built for the architecture, not a copy of the Library: each row holds the title, the URL, the observed pillar, the visible attribution, the page's own title tag and meta description, and one short quoted extract. Governance fields are recorded as unknown, because the public pages do not publish them and nobody here is entitled to guess them. The observations are computed from the fetched pages, not asserted.
